source: اريدك أن تصنع ماب كيبورد يكون فيه ازرار تضغط عليها تاخذ الفلوس تشري سرعه وتعدي العواقب وبدي الماب يكون كبير وعلي شكل ماب kepyord speed

image_prompt.text: The upgrade storefront where players spend the money the keys pay out on speed
Barriers between sections of the keyboard that only open once the player is fast enough or rich enough, which is what the prompt means by getting past the obstacles
Walkable circulation across the keyboard, chaining the shop to the areas where the paying keys are
the whole map built as a giant computer keyboard - keys in rows and columns raised off a flat base, the map silhouette itself a keyboard
individual keys distinguishable as pressable, so a player can see which ones pay

layout_placement.text: Each keyboard key as a pressable station that pays out money when a player steps on it

notes: Incremental Simulator is the shape of the loop: press for money, buy speed, unlock further ground. The keyboard is the theme laid over it, not a different genre.
The word the user uses for what you get past is ambiguous in the original - it reads as either obstacles or consequences. Taken as gated barriers, which fits buying speed to progress.
Nothing in the skill carries the overall silhouette of a map. That the entire world is keyboard-shaped is the whole idea here and survives only as free text in image_prompt.

open_questions.ask: Should the keyboard look like a real computer keyboard, or a stylized bright version?
You said big - is that a full keyboard you can walk the length of, or a few key sections?
What are you working toward - maximum speed, reaching the last key, or is it endless?

coverage_missing.ask: How big is big - a full keyboard layout or a section?
Do the obstacles kill you, or just block until you have enough speed?

answers.ask: Should the keyboard look like a real computer keyboard, or a stylized bright version?
answers.answer: Use a stylized bright keyboard look, matching a fun Roblox keyboard speed map.

answers.ask: You said big - is that a full keyboard you can walk the length of, or a few key sections?
answers.answer: Make it a full large keyboard that players can walk across from one end to the other.

answers.ask: What are you working toward - maximum speed, reaching the last key, or is it endless?
answers.answer: The goal is to gain speed and reach the last key at the end of the keyboard map.
